review:
Inspite of brutal reviews I went ahead and downloaded this game. Now that I've binge played for a few days I'll take the time to review in a more positive light.

Pros: Character Costume Customization,  nice-looking cartoonish avatars, towns/cities well realized, extensive pet-trainer with many pets, card collection, easy to pick up and make money right off the bat

Cons: environments outside of towns and cities seem half empty, poor quest translations (which effects story immesrsion), RNG weapon/armor upgrades (does NOT = pay to win)

If the idea ok a kooky cartoonish and casual mmo sounds fun I definitely give this a thumbs up. The community seems a little low, but the AH is active enough that I made quite a bit selling items already and there are noticable peak times in the cities. The lowest score I could give this would be 3.5/5 stars. Considering that the store doesn't = PTW alone makes me want to give it a bonus half star for a total of 4/5.
